title: Electrical power.
officialText:
The following features serving each fire service access elevator shall be supplied by both normal power
and Type 60/Class 6/Level 1 standby power:
1. Elevator equipment.
2. Elevator hoistway lighting.
3. Ventilation and cooling equipment for elevator machine/control rooms, and machinery/control spaces.
4. Elevator car lighting.
Exception: Standby power relying on natural gas as a fuel source need not be Class 6.
